subject: math
cluster: Visualize relationships between two-dimensional and three-dimensional objects

items.prompt:
A cross section is formed by:
A) Rotating a shape
B) Slicing a solid with a plane
C) Adding two shapes
D) Measuring a side
items.answer: B) Slicing a solid with a plane

items.prompt:
A horizontal slice of a cylinder is a:
A) Rectangle
B) Circle
C) Triangle
D) Square

Any slice of a sphere is a:
A) Square
B) Circle
C) Triangle
D) Rectangle

steps: Every sphere cross section is a circle.

items.prompt:
Rotating a rectangle about one of its sides gives a:
A) Cone
B) Cylinder
C) Sphere
D) Cube

steps: The side becomes the cylinder's axis.

items.prompt:
Rotating a right triangle about a leg gives a:
A) Cylinder
B) Cone
C) Sphere
D) Prism

steps: The leg becomes the cone's axis.

items.prompt:
Rotating a semicircle about its diameter gives a:
A) Cylinder
B) Cone
C) Sphere
D) Cube

steps: The diameter is the axis; it sweeps a sphere.

items.prompt:
A vertical cross section through the axis of a cylinder is a:
A) Circle
B) Rectangle
C) Triangle
D) Oval

steps: A vertical cut through the axis is a rectangle.

items.prompt:
A cross section of a cube parallel to a face is a:
A) Triangle
B) Square
C) Circle
D) Hexagon

steps: Parallel slices match the square face.
